name: Library Prop
prompt:
Create ONE detailed source-compatible reusable GAME ROOM DECOR REFERENCE SHEET. Title INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001 — LIBRARY WRITING & READING DECOR. Exactly TWELVE clean isolated main prop cells in4x3 grid. One main three-quarter or broad-face illustration plus one small useful REAR, UNDERSIDE or OPEN/contact view of SAME object per cell. Short D01–D12 suffix and readable NAME beside each item; full sheet ID in header. Dimensions W,D,H in metres marked PROPOSED, objects may have independent illustration scales. Plain ivory studio background, even light, no humans, rooms, scenery, unlabeled extras or merged objects. Match supplied GEN-24 furniture vocabulary: ivory and rose-veined marble, slender muted gold rose/star/lotus detail, restrained indigo and blush accents. Preserve physical structure and show clear contacts, openings and true back thickness. No generic Gothic arch attached to tiny accessories. Complete tabletop/furniture objects stay human sized, small hardware remains tiny. Empty frames and glass displays must have real clear negative space. These are new source-compatible types, not recovered measured geometry.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D01 — Writing desk. Proposed W,D,H [1.4, 0.65, 0.76]m. One writing desk with empty ivory/rose marble top, one shallow drawer, gold floral apron and four slender legs. No mirror, books, chair or whole room; show rear and underside contacts.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D02 — Reading ladder. Proposed W,D,H [0.55, 0.15, 2.6]m. One straight portable library ladder, exactly two slender side rails, evenly spaced horizontal rungs and two open hooks at top. Front and side show same rung count. No bookcase attached. Dimensions describe upright object before leaning.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D03 — Book stack. Proposed W,D,H [0.3, 0.25, 0.3]m. Three CLOSED illustrated volumes stacked horizontally with distinct covers and page blocks, one coherent stack; no melting shared pages. This is a small prop grouping, not a wall of books.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D04 — Open illustrated book. Proposed W,D,H [0.5, 0.3, 0.05]m. One OPEN illustrated storybook with two page blocks, visible central spine gutter and floral/star page borders. No text-heavy paragraphs, characters or bookstand attached. Show cover underside.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D05 — Closed book spine set. Proposed W,D,H [0.35, 0.2, 0.3]m. Five complete CLOSED volumes standing upright, coherent spines and page blocks with restrained gold titles/motifs. No floating spine-only facade, shelf or wall attached.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D06 — Scroll case. Proposed W,D,H [0.1, 0.1, 0.5]m. One cylindrical scroll case with removable-looking end cap, indigo enamel body and fine gold rose bands. Show capped main view and tiny open circular mouth inset.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D07 — Rolled scroll. Proposed W,D,H [0.4, 0.08, 0.08]m. One rolled parchment scroll with short blush ribbon tie; exposed paper spiral at end. Not a long banner or a second scroll case.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D08 — Quill and ink stand. Proposed W,D,H [0.25, 0.2, 0.35]m. One small flat ivory/gold ink stand with ONE lidded ink bottle and ONE gold quill holder, feather quill inserted. Clear stable base and separated silhouettes; no writing desk attached.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D09 — Bookmark holder. Proposed W,D,H [0.12, 0.12, 0.15]m. One tiny desk bookmark holder: shallow open sleeve on low stable foot, three narrow gold/blush bookmarks seated inside. Not a lamp, flower urn or cabinet.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D10 — Reading wedge cushion. Proposed W,D,H [0.6, 0.6, 0.2]m. One TRIANGULAR reading WEDGE cushion, indigo/blush textile, sloping broad book-support face and flat base. Show side triangle and rear fabric handle. No book or chair; distinct from square accent cushions.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D11 — Library shelf end bracket. Proposed W,D,H [0.2, 0.2, 0.3]m. One SMALL shelf end bracket, gold floral L-shaped corbel, two planar perpendicular fixing surfaces and visible screw seats. No bookshelf, wall or giant column capital.

INT-LIBRARY-PROP-001-D12 — Small catalogue cabinet. Proposed W,D,H [1.2, 0.4, 1.1]m. One low catalogue cabinet with12 small coherent drawers in4columns by3rows, ivory body, fine gold pulls and rose-marble top. Plain back, correct shallow drawer depth. No books or desk added.
Footer: Proposed reference objects; anatomy-free props only; view parity, moving parts and mesh separation require model review.

visual_review_notes: Twelve library props are present, with open scroll case, book page/cover views, ladder side profile, wedge-cushion side and catalogue cabinet rear. Wedge support is distinct from the existing square/round accent cushions.
Fine book counts, ladder hook fit, drawer travel and bracket fasteners remain illustrative. The upright book set is one reference grouping, not proof of individually separable meshes.
Original palace ivory/rose marble, gold star/rose ornament and indigo/blush accents remain consistent. Full IDs resolve under the header plus D01–D12.
